title: Discord Troll
blurb: Built for one purpose: rendering a voice channel unusable. Discord's soundboard feature handed everybody a button that fires audio straight into a live call, and clips like this exist purely to abuse it. Not harmful, not offensive, merely relentless enough that somebody eventually says 'right, who was that'. The comedy lives in repetition and timing, and it invariably lands during the one serious sentence of the night. Load it up for lobby chaos, or deploy it on the friend who has started issuing tactical instructions during a casual game nobody else is taking seriously.
origin: A voice-chat disruption classic from Discord soundboard culture.
